ca20430b105d42.s: The Ramsar Convention on wetlands of international importance was signed in 1971 at:
ca20430b105d42.x: The Convention was signed in 1971 at Ramsar, Iran, and concerns wetlands of international importance; it was not signed at Chilika Lake.

ca88849a1fd359.s: Bhoj Wetlands in Madhya Pradesh was designated a Ramsar site in:
ca88849a1fd359.x: Bhoj Wetlands was designated in 2002, not 2022; it is Sirpur Wetland that was designated in 2022.

ca5896995af2d7.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's Ramsar sites added in 2026?
o: Shekha Jheel Bird Sanctuary was added on 22 April 2026
Shekha Jheel Bird Sanctuary took India's Ramsar total to 99
Shekha Jheel Bird Sanctuary took India's Ramsar total to 98
Surha Tal (Jayaprakash Narayan Bird Sanctuary) took the total to 100
ca5896995af2d7.x: Shekha Jheel took India's total to 99, not 98; Surha Tal, added in June 2026, took it to 100.

ca23a0c7a2eea2.s: Siliserh Lake, one of the Ramsar sites added in 2025, is located in:
ca23a0c7a2eea2.x: Siliserh was one of Rajasthan's three 2025 additions with Menar and Khichan; Bihar's were Gokul, Udaipur Jheel and Goga Beel.

ca6c75406d7af5.s: Menar Wetland Complex in Rajasthan was designated a Ramsar site in:
ca6c75406d7af5.x: Menar Wetland Complex was designated in 2025; Keoladeo dates from 1981 and Sambhar from 1990.

ca7e65f82dbd73.s: Which West Bengal wetland was designated a Ramsar site in 2019?
ca7e65f82dbd73.x: Sundarbans Wetland was designated in 2019; East Calcutta Wetlands, the other West Bengal site, dates from 2002.

ca80eb74c55754.s: How many Ramsar sites did Uttar Pradesh have in June 2026?
ca80eb74c55754.x: Uttar Pradesh has 13 Ramsar sites, second only to Tamil Nadu (20); Rajasthan has 5.

cab213deba5c40.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Tamil Nadu's Ramsar sites?
o: Vembannur Wetland Complex was designated in 2022
Tamil Nadu has 20 Ramsar sites, the most in India
Longwood Shola Reserve Forest was designated in 2024
Gulf of Mannar Marine Biosphere Reserve was designated in 2024
cab213deba5c40.x: Gulf of Mannar Marine Biosphere Reserve was designated in 2022, like Vembannur, not in 2024.

na89f4d198da.s: The Climate Risk Index 2025 is released by:
na89f4d198da.x: The Climate Risk Index is by Germanwatch; EPI is by Yale and Columbia and the State of India's Environment by CSE and Down To Earth.

n3d0751c508d.s: India's rank in the Environmental Performance Index (EPI) 2026 was:
n3d0751c508d.x: India was ranked 176th of 177 in EPI 2026, in which Estonia ranked first.

n2c0c6f046e9.s: UNCCD COP17 (August 2026), with the theme "Restoring Land. Restoring Hope.", was held at:
n2c0c6f046e9.x: UNCCD COP17 was held at Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia; Samarkand hosted CITES CoP20.

nd3eabe2bef0.s: Under the Green Credit Programme (2023), one green credit equals:
o: One tree older than one year
Ten trees older than five years
One hectare of restored forest land
One tree older than five years
nd3eabe2bef0.x: One green credit equals one tree older than five years; the programme rewards voluntary actions and the credits are non-tradable.

n46d658f482a.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India in EPI 2026 and CCPI 2026?
o: The two indices gave identical assessments of India
n46d658f482a.x: The two indices gave opposite pictures: India was 23rd in CCPI 2026 but 176th of 177 in EPI 2026.

n643c5ff3aa6.x: CMS COP15 was held at Campo Grande, Brazil; Ramsar COP15 was at Victoria Falls and UNCCD COP17 at Ulaanbaatar.

nc1f87d3d711.s: The NDC Transport Initiative for Asia is funded by:
nc1f87d3d711.x: NDCTIA is funded by Germany's International Climate Initiative and covers China, India and Vietnam; the UAE and Indonesia lead the Mangrove Alliance for Climate.

n9a38819dc7e.s: The Mangrove Alliance for Climate is led by:
o: The National Mission for Clean Ganga
n9a38819dc7e.x: MAC is led by the UAE and Indonesia; GRCA is led by the National Mission for Clean Ganga and IBCA is India-led.

nba9fe7dcffe.s: Which of the following groups consists of carbon-negative countries?
nba9fe7dcffe.x: Bhutan, Suriname and Panama are carbon-negative; Brazil, South Africa, India and China form the BASIC bloc.

ca27637fd67a88.s: How many pillars did the Global Innovation Index 2026 have?
ca27637fd67a88.x: The GII 2026 had seven pillars, and Creative Outputs was one of them.

ca7387f70cea5c.s: In the Global Business Climate Survey 2026, India's rank among 41 markets was:
ca7387f70cea5c.x: India ranked first among 41 markets and stayed in the Top 3 for the fourth straight year.

ca33aa38aec8c5.s: The Sustainable Development Goals, to be achieved by 2030, comprise how many goals?
ca33aa38aec8c5.x: The SDGs comprise 17 goals and 169 targets, to be achieved by 2030.

ca389305d1a5ad.s: As per MoSPI's Annual Survey of Industries 2024–25, the number of factories in India:
ca389305d1a5ad.x: The survey of organised manufacturing showed factories rising from 2.60 lakh to 2.67 lakh.

cab9fc723b24e9.s: Which States led the Large States category of the India Electric Mobility Index 2025?
cab9fc723b24e9.x: Large States were led by Maharashtra, Karnataka and Tamil Nadu; Manipur, Tripura and Assam led Hilly and NE States, and Delhi, Chandigarh and Goa the UTs/City States.

ca83bf727ca215.s: As per the 7th GCRMN Status of Coral Reefs report, the annual decline in hard coral cover during 2023–24 was:
ca83bf727ca215.x: The annual decline during 2023–24 was 8.9%; 9.5% is the fall in hard coral cover against the 1980–2009 baseline.

cae8d6ceb584e8.s: According to the FAO–Landscape Alliance report 'Forests for Food', how many people depend on forests?
cae8d6ceb584e8.x: Over 5 billion people depend on forests; forests give up to 20% of rural income and wild foods up to 80% of daily protein in remote communities.

cab04321b34b3b.s: According to The Lancet Public Health study, India's second-hand smoke deaths rose from 2,17,700 in 1990 to ____ in 2023.
cab04321b34b3b.x: India recorded 3,25,600 second-hand smoke deaths in 2023, up from 2,17,700 in 1990.

caf6c0d5b41c94.s: Which technologies were highlighted as key in the IEA Special Report on Electrification 2026?
caf6c0d5b41c94.x: The report highlighted transport, buildings and industry, with electric vehicles and heat pumps as the key technologies.

ca321653789f08.s: UNCTAD projected India's GDP growth in 2026, making it the fastest-growing major economy, at:
ca321653789f08.x: India's projected GDP growth for 2026 was 7.3%; Asia accounted for 59% of global growth.

caccbe7846ce07.s: According to the World Development Report 2026, how long did steam take to diffuse to lower-income economies?
caccbe7846ce07.x: The report gives 80 years for steam, 40 years for electricity and 20 years for the internet.

cacf740ef2d59e.s: UNCTAD, which publishes the Trade and Development Report, was established in:
cacf740ef2d59e.x: UNCTAD was established in 1964; the first Trade and Development Report came in 1981.

caf5e76c87b581.s: The International Energy Agency is headquartered in:
caf5e76c87b581.x: The IEA dates from 1974 and is based in Paris, not Geneva.

ca00a963efe18d.s: As per the Gender Snapshot 2026, achieving gender equality may take:
ca00a963efe18d.x: The Gender Snapshot 2026 estimated that gender equality may take 171 years.

ca7ffc1ababc0d.s: The Supreme Court-appointed National Task Force survey on student mental health covered how many students?
ca7ffc1ababc0d.x: The survey covered 2.43 lakh students, not 2.34 lakh; 15% faced severe stress or anxiety.

caa3217cc8fad9.s: As per ADR and National Election Watch, how many sitting legislators in 17 States/UTs changed parties in 2022–2026?
caa3217cc8fad9.x: 111 sitting legislators changed parties: 26 Lok Sabha MPs, 7 Rajya Sabha MPs and 78 MLAs.

ca8745a06e6331.s: In the Data Centre Policy Attractiveness India Index, Andhra Pradesh was placed in:
o: The third tier, with Rajasthan, Tamil Nadu and West Bengal
The second tier, with Odisha, Haryana and Karnataka
The first tier, as the top State
ca8745a06e6331.x: Andhra Pradesh was in the second tier (scores 42–45) with Odisha, Haryana and Karnataka; the third tier scored 30–40.

ca4d93e6e208b5.s: The YouthPOWER rankings in the AP State Handbook of Youth Opportunity used about how many indicators?
ca4d93e6e208b5.x: The assessment used about 180 indicators drawn from 27 databases across five parameters.

caac540ae38896.s: In the Global Financial Centres Index 40, GIFT City was the only Indian centre in the Asia-Pacific Top:
caac540ae38896.x: GIFT City, ranked 37th, was the only Indian centre in the Asia-Pacific Top 15, not Top 10.

caf4d6a5089fa9.s: The WHO Framework Convention on Tobacco Control came into force in:
caf4d6a5089fa9.x: The WHO FCTC was adopted in 2003 and came into force in 2005.

cnc273196c9a9a.s: As per a UNICEF report (October 2026), about how many Indian girls and women were married before the age of 18?
cnc273196c9a9a.x: UNICEF puts the number at about 22.24 crore; about 9.05 crore of them were married before 15.

cn15ab76b43f53.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about child marriage in India?
o: The Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006 sets the minimum age at 18 for women and 21 for men
Ending child marriage falls under SDG target 5.3
NFHS-5 showed a rise from NFHS-4 in women aged 20–24 married before 18
NFHS-5 recorded 23.3% of women aged 20–24 married before 18
cn15ab76b43f53.x: NFHS-5 showed a fall, not a rise: 23.3% against 26.8% in NFHS-4.

cnac0df338020e.s: The Central Electricity Authority was originally set up under:
cnac0df338020e.x: The CEA was set up under the Electricity (Supply) Act, 1948 and now functions under the Electricity Act, 2003, under the Ministry of Power.

cnb667add906dd.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's first National Household Travel Survey?
o: Rural workers spent more on commuting than urban workers
It was conducted by the NSO, MoSPI, from July 2025 to June 2026
The average monthly commuting spend per worker was Rs 785
Urban workers spent about Rs 1,044 a month on commuting
cnb667add906dd.x: Urban workers spent more: Rs 1,044 a month against Rs 612 in rural areas.

cnbbd91bc2cbeb.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about higher-education teachers as per a NITI Aayog report (October 2026)?
o: Teachers rose from 13,67,535 in 2013–14 to 17,32,294 in 2023–24
Nationally there are 87 female teachers per 100 male teachers
The female share of teachers rose from 39% to 45%
The number of teachers rose by over 3.6 lakh between 2013–14 and 2023–24
cnbbd91bc2cbeb.x: The national ratio is 82 female per 100 male teachers; 87 is the figure for ST teachers.

cn5e07fa65b63c.s: As per the NITI Aayog report on higher-education teachers, which States are at gender parity (100 female per 100 male teachers)?
cn5e07fa65b63c.x: Chhattisgarh and Himachal Pradesh are at parity (100); Kerala (182) and Punjab (162) are far above it.

cn32a27bda0e32.s: As per the Global Burden of Disease study, about how many deaths in India in 2023 were linked to second-hand smoke?
cn32a27bda0e32.x: The study linked about 3.25 lakh deaths in 2023 to second-hand smoke.

cn98710f4a9dbd.s: Smoking in public places in India has been banned since:
cn98710f4a9dbd.x: Smoking in public places has been banned since 2 October 2008; about 44.4 crore Indians were exposed to second-hand smoke in 2023.

cn563b50461510.s: According to an iFOREST report (October 2026), India's green economy could create how many jobs by 2035?
cn563b50461510.x: iFOREST estimates the green economy could create 1.3 crore jobs by 2035.

cn423fe7467d05.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Ayush Services Sector Report 2026?
o: Women make up 43% of the Ayush workforce
The sector was valued at USD 36.92 billion in FY2024-25
Day-care centres form the largest segment of the sector by value
Standalone clinics are valued at USD 16.21 billion
cn423fe7467d05.x: Standalone clinics are the largest segment at USD 16.21 billion (43.9%); day-care centres are USD 10.13 billion.

cnbe50518c2b5b.s: UNCTAD's Trade and Development Report 2026 projects global growth in 2026 at:
cnbe50518c2b5b.x: Global growth is projected to fall from 2.9% in 2025 to 2.6% in 2026; India is projected at 7.3%.

cn1efbd7e7bc14.s: India's score of 24.1 in the Global Hunger Index 2026 places it in which category?
cn1efbd7e7bc14.x: A score of 24.1 is in the Serious category; Pakistan (106th, 25.5) ranks below India (100th).

cnf96dec95c46b.s: In the Henley Passport Index 2026, India shares the 84th rank with:
cnf96dec95c46b.x: India shares 84th with Algeria and Mauritania; its rank improved from 85th though visa-free access fell from 57 to 55.

cn9e57e02e4675.s: According to the UNESCO Global Report on Teachers, India is short of about how many teachers?
cn9e57e02e4675.x: The report says India is short of over 11 lakh teachers, from primary to Class 12.

cn0d08c7b8cc35.s: According to the UNESCO Global Report on Teachers (October 2026), how many more teachers are needed globally by 2030?
cn0d08c7b8cc35.x: Globally, 5 crore more teachers are needed by 2030; India has about one lakh single-teacher schools.

cn82925931ac13.s: Jaipur, named in National Geographic's "Best of the World 2027", was founded in 1727 by:
cn82925931ac13.x: Jaipur was founded in 1727 by Maharaja Sawai Jai Singh II and became a UNESCO site in 2019.

cnbccd31ba469d.s: As per the ASI Annual Report 2025-26, foreign visitors to Warangal Fort:
cnbccd31ba469d.x: Foreign visitors to Warangal Fort rose from 280 to 336; Charminar dropped out of the top 10.

cne17abe360920.s: Which country is ranked last (143rd) in the WJP Rule of Law Index 2026?
cne17abe360920.x: Venezuela is last at 143rd (0.26); Afghanistan is 142nd and Denmark tops the index.

cn7468062b7f96.s: The World's 100 Best Museums 2026 ranking is published by:
cn7468062b7f96.x: The ranking is by Worth a Journey, a Germany-based travel guide; the Metropolitan Museum of Art is 10th and the Louvre 31st.

cnad14336f0c65.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the World Bank Poverty and Equity Brief on India (October 2026)?
o: The extreme poverty line used is US$2.15/day (2021 PPP)
About 49.6 crore people were lifted out of extreme poverty
At US$4.20/day (2021 PPP), poverty fell from 57.7% to 16.1%
The extreme poverty line used is US$3.00/day (2021 PPP)
cnad14336f0c65.x: The extreme poverty line is US$3.00/day (2021 PPP), not US$2.15.

cn23c0635b4610.s: India's rank in the Henley Passport Index 2026 is:
cn23c0635b4610.x: India improved from 85th to 84th in the Henley index; 88th is its rank in the WJP index and 100th in the GHI.

new.s: India became a party to the Ramsar Convention on:
new.x: India joined on 1 February 1982; 1971 is the year the Convention was signed and 1981 the year of the first Indian sites.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about India's Ramsar network (June 2026):

2. India ranks third in the world.
3. India had 26 Ramsar sites till 2014.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: All three are correct: India is 1st in Asia and 3rd in the world, and grew from 26 sites (till 2014) to 100 (June 2026).

new.s: Amrit Dharohar, to promote wise use of Ramsar sites, was announced in the Union Budget of:
new.x: Amrit Dharohar was announced in the Union Budget 2023-24 and launched in 2023.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT a component of Amrit Dharohar?
new.x: Its four components are Species and Habitat Conservation, Nature Tourism, Wetlands Livelihoods and Wetlands Carbon Assessment; bonds are not one.

new.s: Ramsar COP15 (23–31 July 2025) was held at:
new.x: Ramsar COP15 was held at Victoria Falls, Zimbabwe, where the Victoria Falls Declaration was adopted.

new.x: Ramsar COP15 adopted the Fifth Strategic Plan for 2025–2034.

new.x: Zimbabwe, host of COP15 at Victoria Falls, took over the presidency for 2025–2028 after China.

new.s: Khecheopalri Wetland, designated a Ramsar site on World Wetlands Day 2025, is in:
new.x: Khecheopalri is Sikkim's only Ramsar site; Udhwa Lake is Jharkhand's.

new.x: Gokul Reservoir is in Buxar (Bihar); Udaipur Jheel is in West Champaran, Khichan in Phalodi and Menar in Udaipur.

new.s: How many Ramsar sites did Karnataka have in June 2026?
new.x: Karnataka has 4 Ramsar sites; Gujarat, J&K, MP and Rajasthan have 5 each.

new.s: Hokersar Wetland and Surinsar–Mansar Lakes of Jammu and Kashmir were designated Ramsar sites in:
new.x: Both were designated in 2006; Hygam and Shallbugh came in 2022 and Wular in 1990.

new.s: Pala Wetland, a Ramsar site of the North-East, is located in:
new.x: Pala Wetland is in Mizoram; Loktak is in Manipur, Rudrasagar in Tripura and Khecheopalri in Sikkim.

new.s: How many of Tamil Nadu's 20 Ramsar sites were added in 2022?
new.x: 13 of Tamil Nadu's 20 sites came in 2022; 4 were added in 2024 and 2 in 2025.

new.x: Both were designated on World Wetlands Day, 2 February 2025.

new.s: In the Climate Change Performance Index 2026, which ranks were left vacant?
new.x: CCPI 2026 left ranks 1–3 vacant; Denmark was 4th and India 23rd, down 13 places.

new.s: The Living Planet Report 2024 reported an average decline in monitored wildlife populations (1970–2020) of:
new.x: LPR 2024 reported a 73% decline; 69% belongs to the 2022 edition and 85% is the freshwater figure.

new.s: As per the Living Planet Report 2024, which region saw the steepest fall in wildlife populations?
new.x: Latin America and the Caribbean fell 95%, ahead of Africa (76%) and Asia-Pacific (60%).

new.s: The State Energy Efficiency Index is prepared by:
o: Bureau of Energy Efficiency with AEEE
new.x: SEEI is prepared by the BEE (Ministry of Power) with AEEE.

new.s: According to the State of India's Environment 2026 in Figures, PM2.5-linked deaths rose in a decade by:
new.x: The CSE–Down To Earth report found PM2.5 deaths up 61% in a decade; Goa was the top State.

new.s: Which city was the most polluted in the World Air Quality Report 2024?
new.x: Byrnihat (Meghalaya) was the most polluted city in 2024; Loni (UP) topped the 2025 edition.

new.s: In the World Air Quality Report 2025, New Delhi was the most polluted capital for the:
new.x: New Delhi was the most polluted capital for the 8th year (PM2.5 82.2 µg/m³), followed by Dhaka and Dushanbe.

new.s: COP30, the first COP held in the Amazon, took place at:
new.x: COP30 (November 2025) was held at Belém, Brazil, and was called the 'COP of Implementation'.

new.s: The Baku-Belém Roadmap agreed at COP30 aims at climate finance of:
new.x: The Baku-Belém Roadmap targets US$1.3 trillion a year by 2035; US$300 billion is the NCQG of COP29.

new.s: COP31 (November 2026) at Antalya, Türkiye, has its negotiations presided over by:
new.x: Under the Australia–Turkey arrangement, Australia presides over the negotiations while Türkiye hosts.

new.s: COP32 (2027), the 'Africa COP', will be held at:
new.x: COP32 is due at Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, in 2027; Sharm el-Sheikh hosted COP27.

new.s: How many species were added to the CITES appendices at CoP20 in Samarkand?
new.x: CITES CoP20 added 77 species; 49% is the share of CMS-listed species in decline.

new.s: CMS COP15 (2026) reported what share of CMS-listed species to be declining?
new.x: CMS COP15 at Campo Grande reported 49% of listed species declining.

new.s: CITES CoP20 at Samarkand was the first CITES CoP held in:
new.x: CoP20 at Samarkand, Uzbekistan, was the first CITES CoP in Central Asia.

new.s: The International Nitrogen Initiative was set up in 2003 under:
o: SCOPE and the International Geosphere-Biosphere Programme
new.x: INI was set up in 2003 under SCOPE and the IGBP to optimise nitrogen use and cut nitrogen pollution.

new.s: The objective of the International Nitrogen Initiative is to:
o: Optimise nitrogen use and cut nitrogen pollution
new.x: INI works to optimise nitrogen use and reduce nitrogen pollution; the others are aims of MAC, NDCTIA and TFFF.

new.s: India joined the Mangrove Alliance for Climate at:
new.x: MAC was launched at COP27 (November 2022), where India joined with Sri Lanka, Australia, Japan and Spain.

new.s: The International Big Cat Alliance (IBCA) is headquartered in:
new.x: IBCA is India-led with its headquarters in New Delhi.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's 'Great Green Wall' and fish-bone technique are associated with:
new.x: Under MISHTI (mangrove restoration, MoEFCC 2023), AP ranked 2nd with its Great Green Wall and fish-bone technique.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about national climate schemes?
o: Carbon credits under the CCTS are non-tradable
The CCTS is run by BEE
new.x: Carbon credits under the CCTS are traded; it is green credits that are non-tradable.

new.s: How many Biosphere Reserves does India have in all (2026)?
new.x: India has 18 Biosphere Reserves; 13 of them are in the UNESCO World Network.

new.s: Hope Spots are designated by:
new.x: Hope Spots are designated by Mission Blue (with IUCN); GSI declares National Geo-Heritage Sites.

new.s: National Geo-Heritage Sites in India are declared by:
new.x: The Geological Survey of India (GSI) declares National Geo-Heritage Sites.

new.s: The only Elephant Reserve of Andhra Pradesh is:
new.x: Koundinya is AP's only Elephant Reserve; Seshachalam is a Biosphere Reserve (2010) and NSTR a tiger reserve.

new.s: How many National Parks does India have (2026)?
new.x: India's PA network has 109 National Parks, 573 Wildlife Sanctuaries and 58 Tiger Reserves.

new.s: Which Andhra Pradesh city is in line for Wetland City status?
new.x: Tirupati is in line for Wetland City status; Guntur was 2nd in Swachh Vayu 2026.

new.s: Hamataliwa papikonda, a new spider species, was found in:
new.x: Hamataliwa papikonda is a spider from Papikonda NP, Andhra Pradesh.

new.s: Rakthamichthys anchi, reported in August 2026, is a:
new.x: Rakthamichthys anchi is a blind, blood-red swamp eel from dug-out wells in Goalpara, Assam.

new.s: The five new Allographa species reported from the Western Ghats (July 2026) are:
new.x: The Allographa species are lichen-forming fungi; Conocephalus are katydids and Piratula a wolf spider.

new.s: Dipturus dhritiae is named after Dhriti Banerjee, the first woman Director of:
new.x: Dhriti Banerjee is ZSI's first woman Director; the deep-sea skate is from the Arabian Sea.

new.s: Mesalina bishnoi is India's first Mesalina:
new.x: Mesalina bishnoi is a lizard, India's first Mesalina; Simonia lawbah is India's first Simonia spider.

new.s: In IUCN Red List 2026-1, the desert rain frog was:
o: Uplisted from Near Threatened to Vulnerable
Downlisted from Endangered to Near Threatened
Downlisted from Vulnerable to Near Threatened
new.x: The desert rain frog worsened from NT to VU; the numbat improved from EN to NT.

new.s: The main threat to Olive Ridley nesting beaches in Odisha reported in August 2026 was:
new.x: Coastal erosion of nesting beaches at Gahirmatha and Rushikulya was the threat flagged in August 2026.

new.s: Which devices are promoted in fishing nets under Operation Olivia?
new.x: Operation Olivia of the Indian Coast Guard promotes Turtle Excluder Devices in nets to protect Olive Ridleys.

new.s: Which Indian State is drafting an Oil Spill Contingency Plan?
new.x: Kerala is drafting an Oil Spill Contingency Plan.

new.s: The oil spill off Qeshm Island (August 2026) occurred in which country's waters?
new.x: Qeshm Island is in Iran, in the Strait of Hormuz; the spill threatened the Hara mangroves.

new.s: India's rank in the World Happiness Report 2026 was:
new.x: India rose to 116th of 147 from 118th; Finland topped for the 9th year.

new.s: India's rank in the Press Freedom Index 2026 was:
new.x: India fell from 151st (2025) to 157th of 180 in 2026.

new.s: India's rank in the Global Peace Index 2026 was:
new.x: India fell to 127th from 115th; Nepal was 111th and Pakistan 152nd.

new.s:

1. India ranked 94th of 169.
2. India entered the top 100 for the first time in this edition.

new.x: Statement 1 is correct: 94th is India's best ever. Statement 2 is wrong: India first entered the top 100 in 2025 (99th).

new.s: Which country was the best-ranked in South Asia in the Global Peace Index 2026?

new.s: Which country was ranked last in the Press Freedom Index 2026?

new.s: The Press Freedom Index is published by:
o: Institute for Economics and Peace, Sydney
new.x: RSF, Paris, publishes the Press Freedom Index; IEP publishes the Global Peace Index.

new.s: India's rank in the Network Readiness Index 2025 was:
